title: Inflammation Pathway Analysis in Mice
author: Fawaz G. Haj
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.ypyfvpw

steps.title: Euthanize Mice
steps.instruction: Euthanize mice using cervical dislocation, unless otherwise requested by the PI or stated in the protocol.

steps.title: Collect Blood and Isolate Plasma
steps.instruction: Collect maximum blood from the portal vein and isolate plasma according to standard protocols or as desired by the P.I.

steps.title: Collect and Process Tissues
steps.instruction: Quickly collect tissues designated by the P.I. The entire collection procedure must be completed within a maximum of 3 minutes.

substeps.instruction: Divide each tissue into three portions.
Snap freeze the first portion in liquid nitrogen.
Store the second portion in RNA later solution.
Fix the third portion in the appropriate fixative solution.

steps.title: Prepare Tissues for Western Blotting
steps.instruction: Lyse tissues into the appropriate lysis buffer for western blotting.

steps.title: Determine Protein Expression and Activation
steps.instruction: Determine total protein expression of MCP1/5, IL-6, and TNF-alpha, and the activation of JNK and p38 in adipose tissue, liver, or other tissues requested by the P.I., following standard Western blotting protocols.
